project.name: host/manifests-contract
project.description: The manifests contract — the host-owned port the host consumes and the OSGi manifests-core bundle implements. Pure POJO jar: the synthesis/explode/update SPIs, their exchange records, NodeEnvContext/NodeEnvContributor, and the shared value/constant types (domain policy + catalog, annotations, the profiles value records). Zero impl, zero pulumi, zero osgi — that purity is what lets R4 re-export the package to the OSGi world via system.packages.extra so both worlds share one copy of the contract.
